Do your linen pieces run large?
settings.answer: Most are cut relaxed on purpose, with room to move in the heat. If you like a closer line, size down; each product page says how the model wears it.

settings.question: I'm between two sizes. Which one?
settings.answer: Take the smaller one in dresses and shirts, the larger one in trousers. Linen gives a little across the hips after a few wears but never shrinks back.

settings.question: Where do I find the measurements?
settings.answer: Under the size selector on every product: bust, waist, hip and length for each size, measured flat on the finished garment.

settings.caption: The band-collar shirt, size M, after twelve washes.

settings.question: Do you make petite or tall lengths?
settings.answer: Trousers come in short (74 cm inside leg), regular (79 cm) and long (84 cm). Dresses are one length; free hemming is offered on the product page.

settings.question: How long is the midi dress on me?
settings.answer: It ends 20 cm below the knee on someone 168 cm tall. Every 5 cm of height moves it about 3 cm.

settings.question: How long do I have to return something?
settings.answer: Thirty days from delivery, unworn and unwashed, with the paper tag still on. Returns in the US are free with the label in your parcel.

settings.question: Can I return something I've washed?
settings.answer: Not for a refund, but if it shrank or lost its shape after one wash on our care instructions, we replace it.

settings.question: When will I get my money back?
settings.answer: Within three working days of your parcel reaching our studio. You get an email the moment we scan it.

settings.question: Can I swap for another size?
settings.answer: Yes, free both ways. Start the swap in your account and we ship the new size as soon as yours is on its way back.

settings.question: What if the colour I want has sold out?
settings.answer: Pick “notify me” on the product page. We cut small runs every six weeks and email you first when it's back.

settings.question: Can I machine wash it?
settings.answer: Yes, at 30°C on a gentle cycle, inside out, with a mild liquid detergent. Skip fabric softener: it coats the fibres and stops linen softening on its own.

settings.question: Can it go in the tumble dryer?
settings.answer: Better not. Dry it on a line or a hanger in the shade; ten minutes in the dryer on low before hanging is the most we'd risk.

settings.question: How do I deal with the creases?
settings.answer: Hang it while still damp and smooth the seams by hand. If you iron, do it slightly damp on a medium setting, inside out. A few soft creases are part of the look.

settings.question: Will it get softer?
settings.answer: Yes. Every piece is stone-washed before it reaches you, and it keeps softening for the first ten or so washes.
